subject: Renewal and expansion — billcode mapping & portal access for multi-entity invoicing
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@openmetro.gov>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenMetro AP <finance@openmetro.gov>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion PO & billing instructions (PO #7890)

Connor —

Thanks for the overview on yesterday's call. We're ready to sign the renewal and add the two additional capacity pools for downtown routes (estimate +30% capacity). Finance is sending PO #7890 attached; they asked for a couple of billing items to be explicit on invoices before they can route for payment:

- Split invoices by department code (TransitOps / Infrastructure) and include our internal billcodes (TransitOps: TR-330; Infrastructure: IN-990) as a line-level field
- Reference PO #7890 on each invoice line and include the Redwood invoice number when available
- Net terms: we require Net45 for public agencies (please confirm)
- AP portal access: please invite finance@openmetro.gov and ap-support@openmetro.gov to Redwood's billing portal so they can download invoices and see invoice line-item breakdowns

Also, we need Redwood's vendor docs for onboarding (W9 or equivalent) and a sample invoice that shows billcode fields so our ERP team can validate. I've attached the signed PO.

Anna Liu
Senior Procurement Specialist
OpenMetro Transit Authority

Attachments: OpenMetro_PO_7890.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@openmetro.gov>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion PO & billing instructions (PO #7890)

Anna —

Appreciate the clear instructions and the PO. Congrats on getting this across the line. We'll do the mapping as requested. Quick notes and next steps:

- We can emit a "billcode" custom field at the invoice line level (we call it "external_billcode") and include the PO reference on every invoice. That will be added to the CSV/PDF export.
- Net terms: Redwood's standard for reserved capacity is Net30, but for public agencies we can approve Net45 for this contract. I'll include the amended term in the contract addendum for signatures.
- Portal access: I'll create a billing-only portal role and invite finance@openmetro.gov and ap-support@openmetro.gov. They will have access to download invoices and export line-item detail.
- Vendor docs: attaching our W9 and a sample invoice that includes the external_billcode column.

Internal ask: Marissa / Ben, can you confirm billing owner and whether we need separate invoice entities (one invoice per department) or a single invoice with line-level billcodes (OpenMetro prefers split invoices but we should confirm technical constraints)? Also confirm whether Treasury needs any special tax withholding language.

I'll prepare the contract amendment link (DocuSign) tonight and send for signature so the PO can be processed against the renewed term.

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Account Executive, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf), invoice_sample_with_billcodes.csv (text/csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion PO & billing instructions (PO #7890)

Thanks for the heads up, Connor. Action items for finance ops: please do the following before we send the amendment to DocuSign: 

1) Confirm invoice format option (preferred: single PDF invoice with line-level billcodes; fallback: two separate invoices per department if AR system requires separate documents)
2) Ensure invoice export includes columns: external_billcode, PO_number, Redwood_invoice_id, line_description, units, unit_price, tax_amount
3) Update billing contact to: OpenMetro AP <finance@openmetro.gov> and add ap-support@openmetro.gov as secondary contact; set portal invites to billing-only role with read/download permissions
4) Approve Net45 for DL-48321 and add an invoice-level note referencing the public-sector concession for Net45 terms
5) Check if Redwood needs to collect VAT or EORI evidence (OpenMetro is US-based; note if later expansion includes EU entities)

Ben — can you draft the invoice template by EOD and drop a test export to the secure drive listed below? Connor, once Ben confirms the template, please send DocuSign for the amendment and route final signed PO to accounts-payable@redwood.ai for booking. I can authorize a 15-day processing grace if OpenMetro's AP needs extra time to finish intake.

-Marissa
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/DL-48321/ammendment

From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@openmetro.gov>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenMetro AP <finance@openmetro.gov>, ap-support@openmetro.gov
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion PO & billing instructions (PO #7890)

Connor / Marissa —

This looks good, thank you. Confirming the following: 

- OpenMetro confirms Net45 for this renewal and the PO reference must appear on every invoice line.
- We prefer a single invoice with line-level billcodes; if Redwood cannot support the line-level export we will accept two invoices (one per department) as an exception.
- Please invite finance@openmetro.gov and ap-support@openmetro.gov to the billing portal.
- Attached is our vendor onboarding form for Redwood to complete; once we see a sample invoice that includes TR-330 and IN-990 in the billcode column, our ERP team will sign off and route payment.

We'll watch for the DocuSign link and the sample export.

Anna Liu
Senior Procurement Specialist
OpenMetro Transit Authority

Attachments: OpenMetro_vendor_form.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
